method: Fresh mechanics_notes-length census over the 474-record canonical index, excluding every skill with a registered current-evidence audit. Selected the four shortest remaining records and rechecked current skill-specific evidence.
evidence_boundaries: Exact frame data is not promoted.
Patch-independent damage/scaling is not inferred from source-reported values.
Hidden interactions and exact charge/resource conversion remain unresolved unless directly documented.
Character-only skills are not converted into CaC acquisition/use claims.
